title: L0-001 Above-Ground Gold Stock — Observation Record
description: Single processed observation for L0-001. One record per observation_year per collection event. Revision events produce a new record with is_revised: true.

observation_year.description: Calendar year the stock estimate represents. Coverage starts 2010 per WGC dataset.

above_ground_stock_tonnes.description: Total accumulated above-ground gold stock in metric tonnes.

jewellery_tonnes.description: Sub-component: jewellery stock in metric tonnes. Null if not published.

bars_coins_etf_tonnes.description: Sub-component: bars, coins, and gold-backed ETFs combined as published by WGC. Must not be split. Null if not published.

central_banks_tonnes.description: Sub-component: central bank holdings in metric tonnes. Null if not published.

other_tonnes.description: Sub-component: other uses in metric tonnes. Null if not published.

source_endpoint.description: Exact URL retrieved by the collector.

underlying_providers.description: Semicolon-separated list of underlying data providers as credited on the WGC page.
underlying_providers.example: Metals Focus; Refinitiv GFMS; World Gold Council

publication_date.description: Date WGC published or last updated this estimate (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

retrieval_timestamp.description: UTC datetime when the collector fetched the file (ISO 8601).

raw_file_path.description: Relative path to the archived .xlsx file in data/raw/.

is_revised.description: True only when this record revises a previously stored observation for the same observation_year. A new year is a new record, not a revision.

prior_publication_date.description: Required and non-null when is_revised is true. Date of the superseded observation.

prior_value_tonnes.description: Required and non-null when is_revised is true. Previously stored total for this observation_year.

revision_reason.description: Required and non-null when is_revised is true. e.g. 'WGC methodology update', 'Metals Focus data revision'.

transformation_notes.description: Any unit conversion or transformation applied. Null if raw value used as-is.

validation_status.description: PASS: all checks passed. FLAG: outside expected bounds but potentially valid; operator review required before scoring. FAIL: implausible or incomplete; do not archive to processed store.

availability_status.description: AVAILABLE on clean retrieval. All other values indicate a degraded or missing-data condition.

anomaly_notes.description: Required when validation_status is FLAG or FAIL. Free text describing the anomaly.
